It is celebrated for its complex layers of passion fruit, grapefruit, and mango, anchored by a distinctive dank, herbal-cannabis character with a touch of pine. This is the Cryo (concentrated lupulin) version, which amplifies Strata's intense tropical fruit and signature dank notes. Use approximately half the amount of standard T90 pellets by weight. With an alpha acid range of 11-15% (higher in Cryo form), Strata is a dual-purpose hop that brings rounded tropical fruit from hot-side additions and bold grapefruit and dank character from dry hopping.

ingredients.name: Czech Saaz-100g
ingredients.description: One of the four original Noble hops, with roots stretching back over 700 years to the town of Zatec in Bohemia. Officially registered in 1952, Saaz defines the character of classic Bohemian lagers with its delicate, refined aroma of mild spice, soft florals, bergamot, honey, and chamomile. With an alpha acid range of 2.5-4.5%, Saaz contributes gentle bitterness and is prized almost entirely for its elegant aroma and flavour. An essential ingredient for authentic Czech Pilsners.

ingredients.description: Made from dark sweet cherries, this puree adds deep, rich cherry flavour to stouts, porters, brown ales, and fruit wines. Sweeter and less acidic than the tart variety. Add during secondary fermentation. No added sugars, preservatives, or artificial flavours.

ingredients.name: Dextrose 500 g package

Yeast readily ferments it into CO2 for natural carbonation with a clean, neutral flavor profile. 500 g package. Priming: approx. 115–140 g per 5 gal (19L) batch or 140–170 g per 23L; for gravity boosting, add to taste.

ingredients.name: Dried Rose Hips 3 oz
ingredients.description: Tart, fruity botanical with sweet apple and plum notes used in wines, meads, and specialty herbal beverages. Rich in vitamin C and adds a delicate floral complexity. Use 1–3 oz (28–85 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch of wine or mead. Add during or after fermentation for best flavour retention.

ingredients.name: El Dorado-100g
ingredients.description: Bred by CLS Farms in the Moxee Valley of Washington State and released in 2010, El Dorado carries genetics tracing back to the wild Neomexicanus hops of Colorado. It is known for its bold, candy-like sweetness with bright tropical aromas of pineapple, watermelon, pear, and stone fruit, backed by a resinous undertone. With an alpha acid range of 13-17%, El Dorado is a true dual-purpose hop that lends soft, balanced bitterness from early additions and intense tropical fruit from late additions and dry hopping.

ingredients.name: Elderberries 1 oz
ingredients.description: Richly colored, tart berries that add fruit character, body, and color to wines, meads, and porters. Always ferment or heat before use, as raw elderberries should not be consumed.

ingredients.name: Falconer's Flight 7 C's-100g
ingredients.description: A proprietary hop blend created by Yakima Chief Hops, combining seven American "C" hops: Cascade, Centennial, Chinook, Citra, Cluster, Columbus, and Crystal, along with additional experimental varieties. The blend delivers strong citrus and fruit character layered with spicy, earthy overtones. With an alpha acid range of 9-12%, Falconer's Flight 7 C's is a dual-purpose blend that works well in all stages of the brewing process. Its balanced complexity makes it a convenient single-hop option for American-style ales.

ingredients.name: Fermaid K 50g
ingredients.description: Blended complex yeast nutrient containing amino acids, sterols, vitamins, and inactive yeast. Promotes vigorous fermentation and compensates for nutrient deficiencies in wine, cider, and mead. Typical usage in wine or mead: 1 g/gal, or approximately 5 g per 5 gal (19L) batch and 6 g per 23L. Add in staggered nutrient additions during early fermentation.

ingredients.name: Fermaid O 100g
ingredients.description: Organic yeast nutrient derived from autolyzed yeast with high amino acid content. Promotes clean fermentation with fewer off-aromas (such as hydrogen sulfide) while enhancing fruit and ester development. Typical usage in wine or mead: 0.75–1.5 g/gal, or approximately 4–7.5 g per 5 gal (19L) batch and 5–9 g per 23L. Add in staggered nutrient additions during early fermentation.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ BE-134 11.5g
ingredients.description:
Recommended for Belgian-style saisons and is characterized by a
particularly high attenuation. It gives fruity aromas with a spicy
character, particularly cloves. This strain will produce highly
refreshing and drinkable beers. Ideal fermentation temperature between
18-28°C (64.4-82.4°F). Slow sedimentation.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ S-04 11.5g
ingredients.description: A well-known, commercial English ale yeast, selected for its fast fermentation character and its ability to form a very compact sediment at the end of the fermentation, helping to improve beer clarity. One 11.5 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch at standard gravity. Use two sachets for high-gravity worts. Ferment at 15–24°C (59–75°F).

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ US-05 11.5g
ingredients.description: A ready-to-pitch dry American ale yeast, SafAle US-05 produces well balanced beers with low diacetyl and a very clean, crisp end palate. With medium sedimentations, and medium final gravities, this workhorse of a yeast is a perfect selection for many ale styles. One 11.5 g sachet is sufficient for a standard 5 gal (19L) or 23L ale batch. Use two sachets for high-gravity worts above 1.065 OG. Ferment at 18–28°C (64–82°F).

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ W-68 11.5g
ingredients.description:
Suitable for a variety of wheat beers and other styles with fruity-spicy
profiles, Fermentis SafAle™ W-68 produces aromatic beers rich in phenols
(notes of clove and pepper) and esters (floral and fruity banana
flavors). Known for medium sedimentation, this strain forms no clumps
and will appear as a powdery haze when resuspended in beer. One 11.5 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch. Ferment at 20–32°C (68–90°F); higher temperatures will accentuate banana and clove character.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafAle™ WB-06 11.5g
ingredients.description: A specialty yeast selected for wheat beer fermentation. The yeast produces subtle estery and phenol flavor notes typical of wheat beers. The choice of Wheat or Weizen bier fans. One 11.5 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch. Ferment at 12–25°C (54–77°F); higher temperatures will increase ester and phenol production.

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafLager™ E-30 11.5g
ingredients.description: Described as the optimal yeast for revealing the esters in Lager beers, Fermentis SafLager™ E-30 produces higher levels of esters than other SafLager™ strains. When fermented at higher temperatures, some subtle isoamyl acetate production is possible. More attenuative than S-33 and S-189, SafLager™ E-30 is low in sulfur and diacetyl production. Featuring nice flocculation and sedimentation, it is suitable for various Asian-style lagers, Mexican lagers, Australasian lagers, American Light lagers and more. One 11.5 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch at standard gravity. Use two sachets for high-gravity lagers. Ferment at 12–15°C (54–59°F).

ingredients.name: Fermentis SafLager™ W-34/70 11.5g
ingredients.description: This famous brewer’s yeast strain from Weihenstephan in Germany is used worldwide. SafLager™ W-34/70 allows the brewing of beers with a good balance of floral and fruity aromas and gives clean flavors and high drinkable beers. One 11.5 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch at standard gravity. Use two sachets for high-gravity lagers or for faster starts. Ferment at 12–15°C (54–59°F) for clean lager character.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #1
ingredients.description: Coarse filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing large particulates down to approximately 5 microns. Use as the first filtration stage for young wines.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #2
ingredients.description: Polish filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing particulates down to approximately 1.8 microns. Use as the second stage after coarse filtration for improved clarity.

ingredients.name: Filter Pads Mini Jet #3
ingredients.description: Sterile-grade filter pads for the Buon Vino Mini Jet wine filter system, removing very fine particulates down to approximately 0.5 microns for crystal-clear results. Use as the final polishing stage.

ingredients.name: Floating Thermometer
ingredients.description: Weighted glass thermometer that floats upright in your mash or wort, allowing you to monitor temperature without holding it. Reads in both Fahrenheit and Celsius, making it essential for precise temperature control during all-grain brewing.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Chit Malt
ingredients.description:
Gambrinus Chit Malt is lightly modified and kilned to a low color, so it
retains the high molecular weight proteins that positively impact beer
foam, body, and haze without influencing beer color. Use at up to 10% of
the grist for traditional lagers or hazy IPA, or to improve head and
body in any style; higher percentages can be beneficial when brewing
low-ABV or NA beers.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Munich Dark Malt
ingredients.description:
A very deeply-kilned Munich malt that combines the color and flavor
characteristics of roasted malt with the mellowness of Munich malt. As
up to 30% of the grain bill for dark lagers, Altbier, Doppelbock, dark
Belgian beers, and brown or red ales, Gambrinus Munich Dark 30L adds a
gorgeous red color with notes of bread crust, toffee, brown sugar,
caramel, cereal, and toast. Use at up to 30% of the grain bill, typically 1–3 lbs (0.5–1.4 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Munich Light Malt
ingredients.description:
Seeking a well-balanced malty beer?  This plump, sweet, and mellow
Munich malt delivers impressions of toast, pretzel, toffee, and caramel,
with nutty and cereal grain background notes. Ideal as the base malt for
amber or red ales, Altbier, Scottish ales, and traditional Bavarian
lagers; we also recommend small inclusions for pale ale, IPA, and other
styles to intensify color and boost the perception of maltiness without
the sweetness of caramel malt. Use as up to 100% for Munich-style beers, or 5–20% of the grain bill in other styles. Typically 1–2 lbs (0.5–1 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch for accent; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Pale Malt
ingredients.description: Our plump 2-row European-style pale ale malt is the base for all beers, and is processed from premium Canadian 2-row barley. Gambrinus Pale Malt is known for its fresh barley and bready character with background notes of biscuit, grain, honey, and hints of nutty and green tea flavor. Use for styles where a rich malt flavor can be shown off, or where a strong malt backbone is needed to balance other strong flavors – IPA, pale ale, brown ale, golden ale, or Scottish and Belgian ales.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Pilsner Malt
ingredients.description:
Processed from the finest Canadian two-row available, this very low
protein base malt is versatile in a wide range of beer styles. Expect
delicate flavors of fresh barley, grain, honey, and bread, along with
distinctive nutty character and suggestions of vanilla when used as the
base for classic Pilsner, Kölsch, pale lager, Belgian ale, session IPA,
and blond ale; or as a portion of the grist for Hefeweizen or Witbier. Use as up to 100% of the grain bill for a 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch; typically 8–12 lbs (3.5–5.5 kg) per 5 gal (19L) or 10–14 lbs (4.5–6.5 kg) per 23L.

ingredients.name: Gambrinus Vienna Malt
ingredients.description:
This mellow kilned malt is the missing link between a Pale and Munich
malt. It is ideal for any amber beer, adding a balanced malty character
with strong suggestions of honey, toffee, and caramel. Use at up to 100%
for traditional Vienna, Märzen, and other amber beer styles, or as a
smaller fraction of the grist to add cereal, biscuit, and toasty notes
to pale ale or IPA, Kölsch and blonde ales, or Belgian styles.

ingredients.name: Glass Carboy 19 liter/5 gal
ingredients.description: Five-gallon glass fermentation vessel ideal for smaller batch fermentations, secondary fermentation, and aging. Glass construction will not scratch or retain odors that could impact flavor.

ingredients.name: Glass Carboy 23 liter/6 gal
ingredients.description: Six-gallon glass fermentation vessel with excellent headspace for standard 5-gallon batches. Non-porous glass will not scratch or retain odors, making it ideal for primary, secondary, and bulk aging of beer, wine, and cider.

ingredients.name: GR Hallertau Mittelfruh-100g
ingredients.description: One of the four original Noble hops and the signature landrace variety of the Hallertau region in Bavaria, Germany. Dating back well over a century, Hallertau Mittelfruh delivers the quintessential noble hop aroma: mild spice, soft florals, hints of lavender and sage, with gentle earthy and herbal undertones. With an alpha acid range of 3-5.5%, Hallertau Mittelfruh provides delicate, refined bitterness best suited to traditional German styles. Its balanced elegance makes it one of the most revered aroma hops in the world.

ingredients.description: Dried grapefruit peel providing fresh, bright citrus aroma and pleasant bitterness. Add near the end of the boil or during secondary fermentation to enhance IPAs, pale ales, and wheat beers.

ingredients.name: Hose Flow Pinch Clamp Large (1/2" OD)
Hose Flow Pinch Clamp Small (3/8" OD)
Huell Melon-100g
ingredients.description: A German aroma hop bred at the Hop Research Center in Hull from a Cascade mother and released in 2012. Huell Melon is distinctive for its intensely fruity character, dominated by honeydew melon with supporting notes of strawberry, apricot, pear, and a touch of vanilla. With an alpha acid range of 6.9-7.5%, Huell Melon is best used in late boil additions and dry hopping where its melon-forward aroma can shine. An excellent choice for fruit-accented wheat beers and lighter ales.

ingredients.description: Triple-scale hydrometer that measures specific gravity (SG), Brix, and potential alcohol percentage to monitor fermentation progress and determine alcohol content in beer, wine, cider, and mead.

ingredients.name: Hydrometer Cylinder 10"
ingredients.description: Ten-inch tall plastic test jar with a weighted base for safely floating and reading hydrometers. Requires only a small sample of liquid and features clear graduations for easy measurement reading.

ingredients.name: Hyperdrive RTD Dry Yeast, WHC - 11g
ingredients.description:
A specialized blend of yeast, nutrients and vitamins that contains
everything needed for sugar-based fermentations to produce a clean RTD
base for hard seltzer drinks or as a strong wash for further
distillation into vodka or gin. This yeast can produce a base product of
up to 18% within a five-day fermentation window. One 11 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch of sugar wash or seltzer base. No additional nutrients required.

ingredients.name: Idaho 7-100g
ingredients.description: Bred by Jackson Hop Farm in Wilder, Idaho and released for commercial use in 2015. Idaho 7 stands out for its bold, multi-layered aroma of apricot, orange, red grapefruit, and papaya, with deeper notes of resinous pine and black tea. With an alpha acid range of 12-16%, Idaho 7 is a versatile dual-purpose hop that delivers smooth bitterness from early additions and intense tropical-citrus character from late hopping and dry hopping.

ingredients.name: Irish moss 1 oz
ingredients.description: Natural carrageenan-based clarifying agent added during the last 15 minutes of the boil. Coagulates proteins and tannins to produce clearer, brighter beer with improved cold-break formation. Use 1 tsp/5 mL (approximately 4 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch, added during the last 15 minutes of the boil. Scale to 1.25 tsp/6 mL per 23L.

ingredients.name: Kerry Yeastex® 82
ingredients.description:
Yeastex® 82 is a formulation of specific yeast nutrients to increase yeast viability and activity during fermentation, allowing the end attenuation to be reached in a shorter time, and promoting consistent fermentation profiles.

Yeastex® 82 is a source of zinc and contains high levels of both inorganic and organic nitrogen and vitamins, making it particularly useful when brewing with low FAN malts and in high gravity worts. It should be slurried in a few gallons of water and added to the kettle about 15 minutes before strike-out. Typical dosage: 1 g/L of wort, or approximately 19 g per 5 gal (19L) batch and 23 g per 23L batch.

ingredients.name: Krush (HBC 586)-100g
ingredients.description: An experimental variety bred by the Hop Breeding Company in 2007 and commercially released in 2024 after 17 years of development. Krush bursts with citrus orange, tropical mango and guava, ripe peach, mixed berry, and woody resin. The complexity and punch of its aroma profile made it a favourite among brewers long before its official release. With an alpha acid range of 10-14%, Krush is a dual-purpose hop that performs well in all additions, delivering bold tropical and citrus character alongside firm, clean bitterness.

ingredients.name: Lactic Acid 88%
ingredients.description:
88% solution. Used for mash pH adjustment, as well as acid balancing in
seltzers and FMBs. Typical usage: 1–3 mL per 5 gal (19L) mash for pH adjustment; add incrementally and measure with a pH meter. Results vary with source water, so always verify with a pH reading.

ingredients.name: Lactose
ingredients.description: Non-fermentable milk sugar that adds subtle sweetness, creamy mouthfeel, and body without increasing alcohol content. Popular in milk stouts, cream ales, and fruit-forward beers. Sold by the gram. Use 8–16 oz (225–450 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch for milk stouts, or 4–8 oz (115–225 g) for subtle sweetness. Add during the last 15 minutes of the boil. Scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Lalvin EC-1118 Yeast 5g
ingredients.description: The EC-1118 strain was isolated, studied and selected from Champagne fermentations. Due to its competitive factor and ability to ferment equally well over a wide temperature range, the EC-1118 is one of the most widely used yeasts in the world. One 5 g sachet per 5–6 gal (19–23L) batch of wine, cider, or mead. Rehydrate in warm water (40°C/104°F) for 15 minutes before pitching. Ferments cleanly across 10–30°C (50–86°F).

ingredients.name: Magnum-100g
ingredients.description: A high-alpha bittering hop bred at the Hop Research Center in Hull, Germany in 1980 and registered in 1993. Magnum is a daughter of Galena and a German male breeding line. It is valued for its clean, efficient bitterness with subtle undertones of black pepper, nutmeg, and faint citrus. With an alpha acid range of 11-15%, Magnum is primarily a bittering workhorse that provides a smooth, neutral foundation without harsh edges. A staple choice for clean-bittered lagers and balanced ales.

ingredients.name: Malic Acid-100g
ingredients.description: A naturally occurring fruit acid that adds a crisp, tart apple-like character. Used in winemaking to adjust acidity and in brewing for sour styles, seltzers, and ciders. Typical usage in wine: 1–4 g/L to taste; in brewing or cider: 1–3 g per 5 gal (19L) batch to desired tartness.

ingredients.name: Malto-Dextrin 8oz package
ingredients.description: Non-fermentable dextrin powder that increases body, mouthfeel, and head retention in beer without affecting flavor or alcohol content. Particularly useful in light-bodied extract brews. Use 4–8 oz (115–225 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch for added body, or scale to 5–10 oz (140–280 g) per 23L. Add during the last 15 minutes of the boil.

ingredients.name: Monster Mill MM-2 3/8" Driveshaft Grain Mill - with Hopper and Base
ingredients.description: Professional two-roller homebrew grain mill featuring two 6-inch steel rollers on an aluminum block frame with adjustable gap. Includes hopper, base, and 3/8" driveshaft that accepts a standard electric drill for consistent grain crushing.

ingredients.name: Mosaic-100g
ingredients.description: Released in 2012 by the Hop Breeding Company, Mosaic is the daughter of Simcoe and Nugget. True to its name, Mosaic delivers a complex tapestry of mango, tangerine, peach, passionfruit, blueberry, earthy pine, and herbal notes. Its layered complexity has made it one of the most sought-after craft brewing hops. With an alpha acid range of 11.5-13.5%, Mosaic is a triple-use hop that provides smooth bitterness, distinctive flavour, and intense aroma. Its strength lies in its ability to add depth and complexity whether used alone or in combination.

It offers a complex blend of herbal, woody, and minty notes with hints of pine and lemon balm. With an alpha acid range of 6-10%, Northern Brewer provides moderate, well-rounded bitterness and a distinctive minty-earthy aroma that suits both English and German styles.

ingredients.name: Nugget-100g
ingredients.description: A high-alpha bittering hop developed in 1982 from a cross of Brewer's Gold and a high-alpha wild hop. Nugget is a workhorse variety valued for its clean, strong bitterness and mild herbal aroma. It carries subtle notes of pine, spice, and light floral character. With an alpha acid range of 11-14%, Nugget delivers firm, smooth bitterness that works well as a base layer in a wide range of styles. A reliable choice for any brew where clean bittering is the goal.

ingredients.name: NZ Wai-iti-100g
ingredients.description: Developed by New Zealand Plant and Food Research and released in 2011, Wai-iti is a granddaughter of Liberty and carries one-third Hallertau Mittelfruh genetics. It was selected for its low alpha acid content and high essential oil levels, delivering lush aromas of peach, apricot, lime, and mandarin. With an alpha acid range of 2-3.5%, Wai-iti is a pure aroma hop that provides a rounded, clean bitterness thanks to its low cohumulone. Best used in mid-to-late additions and dry hopping where its stone fruit and citrus character can fully develop.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals American Char 2pk
ingredients.description: American oak spirals with charring that provide bold caramelized wood and smoky notes. Adds deep complexity and color stabilization to wine, whiskey, and barrel-aged beer. Use 1 spiral per 5–6 gal (19–23L) carboy. Taste weekly; typical contact time is 4–6 weeks as charred oak extracts more quickly.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals French Medium 2pk
ingredients.description: French oak spirals with medium toast imparting warm vanilla, sweet oak, and subtle cinnamon notes. High surface area design allows full flavor extraction in approximately 6 weeks, making them perfect for carboy-aged wine and spirits. Use 1 spiral per 5–6 gal (19–23L) carboy. Taste weekly; typical contact time is 4–8 weeks depending on desired intensity.

ingredients.name: Oak Spirals French Medium+ 2pk
ingredients.description: French oak spirals with an enhanced toast level offering deeper vanilla, caramel, and toasted bread complexity. Provides refined oak aging character with slightly more intensity than standard medium toast. Use 1 spiral per 5–6 gal (19–23L) carboy. Taste weekly; typical contact time is 4–8 weeks depending on desired intensity.

ingredients.name: OiO Brewers Rice Hulls
ingredients.description: Parboiled rice hulls improve filter bed performance and reduce the risk of stuck sparge in adjunct-heavy mashes. Use at 2–5% of the grain bill by weight, typically 4–8 oz (115–225 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: OiO Flaked Corn
ingredients.description:
These are mash ready and will provide subtle flavor and mouthfeel
contributions to beer. Suitable for up to 40% of grist total. This is a
pre-gelatinized flaked grain that does not require milling. 89.9% extract. Typically 1–3 lbs (0.5–1.4 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch for light body and crispness; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: OiO Flaked Rice
ingredients.description:
Rice flakes will provide subtle flavor and mouthfeel contributions to
beer. Suitable for up to 40% of grist total. 89.9% extract. Typically 1–2 lbs (0.5–1 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch for a lighter, crisper body; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: OiO Rolled Oat Flakes
ingredients.description:
Mash ready oat flakes will add a distinct full- bodied flavour and
creamy texture. Can be used in amounts of up to 30% of grist total. This
is a pre- gelatinized flaked grain and does not require milling.

ingredients.name: Orange Peel Bitter 1 oz
ingredients.description: Dried Curaçao bitter orange peel adding mild citrus character and subtle bitterness. A classic ingredient in Belgian witbiers, saisons, and holiday ales. Use 0.5–1 oz (14–28 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch, added during the last 5–10 minutes of the boil. Scale to 0.75–1.25 oz (21–35 g) per 23L.

ingredients.name: Orange Peel Sweet 1 oz
ingredients.description: Dried sweet orange peel providing pronounced, pleasant orange flavor and aroma without the bitterness of Curaçao peel. Popular in Belgian strong ales, wheat beers, and specialty brews. Use 0.5–1 oz (14–28 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch, added during the last 5–10 minutes of the boil. Scale to 0.75–1.25 oz (21–35 g) per 23L.

ingredients.name: PBW
ingredients.description: PBW is a buffered alkaline detergent that has been proven to be more than an effective substitute for caustic soda cleaners. Because of its unique formulation of buffers and mild alkalis, it is safe on soft metals such as stainless steel, aluminum, and on plastics. P.B.W. uses active oxygen to penetrate carbon or protein soils and is not affected by hard water. The oxygen also helps in reducing B.O.D. and C.O.D. in wastewater, which is an added environmental benefit.

ingredients.name: Pectic Enzyme (Pectinase) 28g / 1oz
ingredients.description: Enzyme powder used in winemaking and cidermaking to break down pectin in fruit, improving juice extraction and preventing pectin haze in the finished product. Added to must before fermentation begins. Essential for fruit wines and any recipe using fresh or frozen fruit.

ingredients.name: PET Carboy 23 liter/6 gal
ingredients.description: Lightweight, BPA-free plastic fermentation vessel with a smooth, ribless design for easy cleaning and sediment observation. Six-gallon capacity is perfect for secondary fermentation and bulk aging of 5-gallon batches.

ingredients.name: Potassium Metabisulphite
ingredients.description:
Commonly used as a wine equipment sanitizer.

Potassium Metabisulfite is also used as an oxidation preventer and microorganism inhibitor in wine. 

To Sanitize Equipment: Use 4 tsp. powder per 1/2 gal. of water. Requires 5 min contact time, drip dry. To Sanitize Wine before adding yeast: Use 1/2 tsp. powder per 6 gal. of wine.

ingredients.name: Potassium Sorbate
ingredients.description: Wine and mead stabilizer that prevents yeast reproduction after fermentation, blocking refermentation in sweetened beverages. Use in combination with potassium metabisulfite for best results. Sold by the gram.

ingredients.name: Powdered Brewery Wash (PBW) Cleaner 400g
ingredients.description:
A non-caustic alkaline cleaner made for brewing equipment. No scrubbing needed, just soak and rinse. Safe on stainless steel, glass, plastic, and rubber.
Usage: Dissolve 30g per litre in warm water. Soak 30 minutes warm or overnight cold. Rinse thoroughly. Follow with a sanitizer before use. PBW cleans but does not sanitize.
Safety: Skin-safe at working dilution. Avoid eye contact. Store sealed in a cool, dry place.

ingredients.name: Pry-off Crown Caps Gold - 120 pack
ingredients.description: Standard 26mm crown caps for sealing all standard beer bottles. Compatible with all common bench and hand cappers. 120 caps per pack.

ingredients.name: Racking Cane/Hose Clip 1/2 inch
ingredients.description: Plastic clip that secures a 1/2 inch racking cane in place on your carboy or bucket, allowing controlled lowering to minimize sediment disturbance during transfer.

ingredients.name: Rahr Extra Pale Wheat
ingredients.description: Extra Pale White Wheat malt has the sweet malty flavor of other malted grains, with an irresistible light doughy aroma. Wheat malts are high in protein, which helps produce fuller-bodied beers. Wheat malt can improve head formation and retention, depending upon the other grist constituents. White wheat is easier to mill than red wheat, and more conducive to the haze characteristic of Belgian white beers. Rahr Extra Pale White Wheat is suitable for all wheat-style beers and anywhere its foam-forward contributions will be appreciated. Use at 30–70% of the grain bill for wheat beers, or 5–15% in other styles for body and head retention. Typically 3–7 lbs (1.4–3.2 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Rahr Malted Oats
ingredients.description:
Rahr Malted Oats is your new go-to for adding foam stability and a creamy texture to beer. Ideal for juicy or hazy IPA, stout, porter, or any beer style where increased foam development and silky mouthfeel is desired. Rahr Malted Oats bring earthy, grainy flavors as well as palate fullness.

It is high in protein, but low in color and beta glucans, which reduces the risk of slow or stuck lauter. Use at 5–20% of the grain bill for most styles, or up to 30% in hazy IPAs and stouts. Typically 1–3 lbs (0.5–1.4 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Red Tart Cherry Fruit Puree (1.39kg / 49oz can)
ingredients.description: Puree of Montmorency tart cherries, perfect for Belgian-style ales, lambics, sours, and ciders. Delivers a bright, tangy cherry flavour with natural acidity. Add during secondary fermentation. No added sugars, preservatives, or artificial flavours

ingredients.name: Saphir-100g
ingredients.description: A refined German aroma hop developed at the Hop Research Center in Hull and released in 2002. Saphir carries a distinctive blend of tangerine citrus, juniper spice, red fruit, and bergamot, with hints of lemongrass and black tea in cold infusion applications. With an alpha acid range of 2-4.5%, Saphir is a pure aroma hop best suited to late additions where its complex, layered character can develop. A versatile choice that bridges traditional German brewing with modern craft styles.

ingredients.name: Sarsaparilla Root Mexican 2 oz
ingredients.description: Traditional root beer flavoring ingredient with a slightly bitter, woody character. Natural saponins help produce a foamy head. Pairs well with vanilla, licorice, and wintergreen in homemade soda and root beer recipes. Use 1–2 oz (28–56 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch of root beer or herbal soda. Simmer for 30–60 minutes to extract flavour.

ingredients.name: Scott'tan Tannin FT Blanc
ingredients.description: Premium gall nut tannin by Scott'Tan designed specifically for white wines, fruit wines, and meads. Provides antioxidant protection, improved mouthfeel, and enhanced perception of body and sweetness. Sold by the gram. Typical dosage: 5–20 g/hL (0.2–0.8 g per gal), or approximately 1–4 g per 5 gal (19L) batch. Add during or after fermentation.

ingredients.name: Scott'tan Tannin FT Rouge
ingredients.description: Premium ellagic tannin by Scott'Tan designed for red wines and rosés. Enhances colour stability, structure, and mouthfeel while providing antioxidant protection. Typical dosage: 5–30 g/hL (0.2–1.1 g per gal), or approximately 1–6 g per 5 gal (19L) batch. Add during or after fermentation.

ingredients.name: Scott'tan Tannin Riche
ingredients.description:
Tannin Riche is a cellaring and finishing tannin notable for enhancing complexity.

Derived from 100% toasted French oak, Tannin Riche imparts hints of coconut and vanilla together with a perception of sweet­ness. It can contribute the final touch to your wine. Typical dosage: 1–5 g/hL (0.04–0.2 g per gal), or approximately 0.2–1 g per 5 gal (19L) batch. Add during élevage or before bottling.

ingredients.name: Silicon Bung #8 Drilled
ingredients.description: Food-grade silicone stopper with a center hole drilled to fit standard airlocks, designed for use with carboys and fermentation vessels. Durable, heat-resistant, and will not impart flavors to your brew.

ingredients.name: Silicon Food-Grade Hose - 1/2" ID (5/16" OD) x 2 meters
ingredients.description: Food-grade silicone tubing with a ½" (13 mm) inner diameter, ideal for transferring wort, beer, wine, and cider between vessels. Heat-resistant up to 230°C (450°F), making it safe for hot-side transfers. Will not impart flavours or odours, and cleans easily with PBW or Star San. 2-metre length.

ingredients.name: Simcoe-100g
ingredients.description: Released in 2000 by Yakima Chief Ranches in the Pacific Northwest, Simcoe (originally designated YCR 14) has become a cornerstone of American craft brewing. Its parentage is proprietary. Simcoe is celebrated for its complex bouquet of grapefruit, resinous pine, passionfruit, and a signature dank character, with underlying notes of berry and apricot. With an alpha acid range of 12-14%, Simcoe is a dual-purpose hop that excels at both clean bittering and bold late-addition aroma. Its blend of citrus, pine, and earth makes it a natural partner in hop blends.

ingredients.name: Simpsons Maris Otter
ingredients.description: Premium English heritage base malt with low nitrogen and high extract, delivering rich, slightly nutty flavor with biscuit and bread crust notes. Ideal for traditional British ales, bitters, and pale ales. Use as up to 100% of the grain bill. Typically 8–12 lbs (3.5–5.5 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch or 10–14 lbs (4.5–6.5 kg) per 23L.

ingredients.name: Spalter Select-100g
ingredients.description: Bred at the Hop Research Center in Hull, Germany and released in 1993, Spalter Select was developed to capture the refined aroma qualities of the classic Spalt landrace with improved disease resistance and growing performance. It delivers clean, noble-style aromas of gentle spice, soft florals, and herbal earthiness. With an alpha acid range of 3-6.5%, Spalter Select is an aroma hop that excels in late boil additions and dry hopping. Its delicate, well-balanced character makes it ideal for traditional European lager and ale styles.

ingredients.name: Star San Sanitizer 32oz
ingredients.description: Five Star's trusted no-rinse acid-based sanitizer for homebrewing and winemaking equipment. Dilute 1 oz per 5 gallons of water and it sanitizes on contact in under 2 minutes with natural foaming action. 32 oz bottle.

ingredients.name: Star San Sanitizer 8oz
ingredients.description: Five Star's trusted no-rinse acid-based sanitizer for homebrewing and winemaking equipment. Dilute 1 oz per 5 gallons of water and it sanitizes on contact in under 2 minutes with natural foaming action. 8 oz bottle.

ingredients.name: Tartaric Acid-100g
ingredients.description: A natural acid used primarily in winemaking to adjust acidity and balance sweetness. Can also be used for mash pH adjustment in brewing. Typical usage in wine: 1–4 g/L to taste; in brewing: 1–3 g per 5 gal (19L) mash as needed for pH adjustment.

ingredients.name: Tartaric Acid-25g
ingredients.description: A natural acid used primarily in winemaking to adjust acidity and balance sweetness. Can also be used for mash pH adjustment in brewing. Typical usage in wine: 1–4 g/L to taste; in brewing: 1–3 g per 5 gal (19L) mash as needed for pH adjustment.

ingredients.name: Tartaric Acid-50g
ingredients.description: A natural acid used primarily in winemaking to adjust acidity and balance sweetness. Can also be used for mash pH adjustment in brewing. Typical usage in wine: 1–4 g/L to taste; in brewing: 1–3 g per 5 gal (19L) mash as needed for pH adjustment.

ingredients.name: Thomas Fawcett Pale Chocolate Malt
ingredients.description: Lightly roasted English specialty malt with mild chocolate and coffee notes, less intense than regular chocolate malt. Adds complexity and color to dark milds, brown ales, porters, and stouts. Use at 3–10% of the grain bill, typically 4–12 oz (115–340 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: UK East Kent Golding-100g
ingredients.description: One of the oldest and most revered English hop varieties, East Kent Golding was brought to market in 1790, bred from a wild Canterbury Whitebine. Grown exclusively in East Kent by a small number of dedicated growers, it defines classic English hop character with smooth, delicate aromas of spice, honey, lavender, thyme, and a touch of lemon. With an alpha acid range of 4-5.5%, East Kent Golding provides gentle, refined bitterness and elegant aroma. It is the traditional finishing hop for English cask ales and remains essential for authentic British styles.

ingredients.name: UK East Kent Golding-500g
ingredients.description: One of the oldest and most revered English hop varieties, East Kent Golding was brought to market in 1790, bred from a wild Canterbury Whitebine. Grown exclusively in East Kent by a small number of dedicated growers, it defines classic English hop character with smooth, delicate aromas of spice, honey, lavender, thyme, and a touch of lemon. With an alpha acid range of 4-5.5%, East Kent Golding provides gentle, refined bitterness and elegant aroma. It is the traditional finishing hop for English cask ales and remains essential for authentic British styles.

ingredients.name: UK Fuggle-100g
ingredients.description: A cornerstone of British brewing since 1875, Fuggles is prized for its mild, pleasant character. Expect earthy, woody, and gently floral notes with a soft herbal undertone. The aroma is rounded and inviting, with hints of damp countryside, fresh-cut grass, and a touch of fruit. With an alpha acid range of 3-5%, Fuggles is a classic finishing and aroma hop that contributes smooth bitterness without sharpness. Essential for traditional cask ales.

ingredients.name: UK Fuggle-500g
ingredients.description: A cornerstone of British brewing since 1875, Fuggles is prized for its mild, pleasant character. Expect earthy, woody, and gently floral notes with a soft herbal undertone. The aroma is rounded and inviting, with hints of damp countryside, fresh-cut grass, and a touch of fruit. With an alpha acid range of 3-5%, Fuggles is a classic finishing and aroma hop that contributes smooth bitterness without sharpness. Essential for traditional cask ales.

ingredients.name: Verdant IPA Dry Ale Yeast, LalBrew® Lallemand - 11g
ingredients.description: Verdant IPA yeast is highly versatile and well suited for NEIPAs, Hazy IPAs, English IPAs and Bitters, American Pale Ales, Stouts, and many other beer styles. Specially selected in collaboration with Verdant Brewing Co. in the UK for its ability to produce a wide variety of hop-forward and malty beers. Prominent notes of apricot and undertones of tropical fruit and citrus merge seamlessly with hop aromas. With medium-high attenuation, LalBrew® Verdant IPA leaves a soft and balanced malt profile with slightly more body than a typical American IPA yeast strain. One 11 g sachet per 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch at standard gravity. Use two sachets for high-gravity IPAs. Ferment at 18–23°C (64–73°F).

ingredients.name: Weyermann CARAFA Special Type 2
ingredients.description: Dehusked (debittered) dark roasted malt with smooth coffee, cocoa, and chocolate flavors. Adds deep color and body without the harsh astringency of standard roasted malts. Excellent in schwarzbier, porter, and stout. Use at 1–5% of the grain bill for color and flavor, typically 2–8 oz (55–225 g) per 5 gal (19L) batch; scale proportionally for 23L.

ingredients.name: Weyermann Floor-Malted Bohemian Pilsner
ingredients.description: Traditionally floor-malted Czech lager malt with earthy character and notes of biscuit and honey. Produces pale golden wort perfect for authentic Bohemian pilsners and European-style lagers. Use as up to 100% of the grain bill. Typically 8–12 lbs (3.5–5.5 kg) per 5 gal (19L) batch or 10–14 lbs (4.5–6.5 kg) per 23L.

ingredients.name: Whirlfloc Tablets (25 pack)
ingredients.description: Clarifying tablet used in brewing to reduce haze and improve beer clarity. Added during the last 5–10 minutes of the boil, Whirlfloc binds to proteins and tannins, causing them to settle out. A single tablet treats a standard 5-gallon batch. Made from refined Irish moss (carrageenan).

ingredients.name: Wine Conditioner 500 mL
ingredients.description:
To be added to wine after stabilizing and clearing to sweeten to taste.
Recommended dosage: 7 mL/L (1 ½ tsp/L)

ingredients.name: Wine Thief 3pc Plastic
ingredients.description: Three-piece plastic sampling tool approximately 18 inches long that collects small samples without agitation or aeration. Disassembles for easy cleaning and allows testing with a hydrometer or by taste.

ingredients.name: WLP820 Oktoberfest Lager - Liquid Yeast
ingredients.description: Brings out rich malt nuances with a balanced residual sweetness. Ferment at 11–14°C (52–58°F) with medium flocculation and 65–73% attenuation. Perfect for Oktoberfest, Märzen, and malty lager styles. A 1–2L starter is recommended for a standard 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch.

ingredients.name: WLP860 Munich HelleLager - Liquid Yeast
ingredients.description: A clean, crisp lager strain that highlights malt sweetness and produces a smooth finish. Best fermented at 9–11°C (48–52°F) with medium flocculation and 68–72% attenuation. Ideal for Helles, Rauchbier, and German lager styles. A 1–2L starter is recommended for a standard 5 gal (19L) or 23L lager batch.

ingredients.name: WLP920 Old Bavarian Lager - Liquid Yeast
ingredients.description: A traditional Bavarian strain that finishes with a malty character and slight ester profile. Ferment at 10–13°C (50–55°F) with medium flocculation and 66–73% attenuation. Excellent for Oktoberfest, Märzen, bocks, and dark lagers. A 1–2L starter is recommended for a standard 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch.

ingredients.name: WLP940 Mexican Lager - Liquid Yeast
ingredients.description: Produces clean, crisp lagers with subtle malt sweetness. Ferment at 10–13°C (50–55°F) with medium flocculation and 70–78% attenuation. Well suited for Mexican-style lagers and other light, crisp lager styles. A 1–2L starter is recommended for a standard 5 gal (19L) or 23L batch.
